data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin that helps you create introductory slides and walkthroughs for apps.
data.what_it_does: It provides a customizable slider widget specifically designed for app intros and walkthroughs. Developers can configure pages using built-in content options (titles, descriptions, images, background colors) or custom widgets.
use_when: You need to build a first-run walkthrough or onboarding intro for your Flutter app.
You want customized navigation buttons, indicators, and animations for slides out of the box.
avoid_when: You are building complex page-view workflows that are not standard app intros or onboarding flows.
You require a general-purpose carousel for content delivery rather than a linear intro screen.
strengths: Easy to configure with pre-built content configs or fully custom tabs.
Supports custom indicators, navigation buttons, and scroll behaviors.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited to intro slider and onboarding use cases.
Advanced layout customizations may require writing custom tabs manually.
data.setup_notes: Add intro_slider to pubspec.yaml and import package:intro_slider/intro_slider.dart.

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick carousel_slider if you need a general-purpose image or card carousel rather than a dedicated onboarding intro flow.
